import sys, json, time
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from coord.synthesis_runner_v3 import synth

START = time.time()
json_path, md_path = synth()
dur = round(time.time() - START, 6)
print("=== Grand Synthesis v3 Runner (Tick 25) — Retry ===")
print(json.dumps({"json_artifact": json_path, "markdown_summary": md_path, "timing_sec": dur}, indent=2))
print("Grand synthesis v3 retry complete.")
